messages:
Mia (Design): quick design review — compact Rollout History mock up here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/rollout-compact (please open in desktop). goal: surface rollback affordance inline (no modal), show canary allocations, and reduce visual noise for power users. looking for contrast/copy/focus feedback.
Arjun (PM): +1. main product ask: make rollback discoverable but low-risk. curious about having a small confirm inline instead of a full modal. also: we should avoid showing too many decimals for canary %. :eyes:
Sam (Eng): inline confirm is doable. impl notes: use virtualization for long history to keep perf; expanding an item to reveal rollback CTA should be a DOM toggle — avoid heavy reflow. also if we make the rollback a secondary action, ensure keyboard focus lands on it.
Elaine (A11y): a11y quick pass: pills need color contrast >= 4.5:1 with bg for text. keyboard order looks off in the mock — when you tab into a version row you should hit the timeline, then the details, then the rollback button. add aria-expanded on the row. also add aria-live="polite" to the rollout-status region for screenreader updates.
a11y-bot: automated scan: contrast fail on .pill-muted (#6B7681 on #FFFFFF) — ratio 3.2:1. recommended swap to #5A6673 or increase weight.
Mia (Design): thanks Elaine + a11y-bot — will boost contrast and add aria-expanded. quick copy question: options for rollback CTA: 1) "Rollback to v2.3" 2) "Start rollback" 3) "Revert to previous" — which reads clearest?
Arjun (PM): I prefer 1 for clarity in logs/alerts (explicit version). 2 is more action-y but ambiguous which version. we should A/B test 1 vs 2 in Console to see click drop.
Sam (Eng): +1 for 1. also consider microcopy under the button: "instant. can be undone within 5m" (if we support quick undos). avoids surprise.
Mia (Design): note on density: current compact row height = 36px. if we add percent inline it bumps to 48px. alternatives: show % on hover or as muted tiny text. thoughts?
Elaine (A11y): percent on hover is not accessible for keyboard-only users. recommend visible tiny text for keyboard focus, and on hover show tooltip for mouse. keep contrast for tiny text at least 3:1 with bg per AA for large text? (tiny is tricky).
Sam (Eng): implement tiny text option. CSS snippet I propose for focus outline:``` .version-row:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--interactive); outline-offset: 2px; } ``` ensures visible focus ring without changing layout.
Mia (Design): love that. one more: rollback confirmation pattern — inline confirm vs sliding tray vs modal. preference? keep product flow in mind (audit logs, ability to cancel).
Arjun (PM): inline confirm + explicit log entry seems best — no modal to interrupt power users. but for rollbacks that touch infra (e.g., DB migration) we'll still use modal with extra checklist.
Elaine (A11y): if using inline confirm, ensure it is reachable by keyboard and announced via aria-live when performed: "Rollback started: v2.3 -> v2.2, estimated 45s". also trap focus only for modal flows.
a11y-bot: suggestion: add role="status" to the rollout-status region for better SR announcement of progress.
Mia (Design): action items: 1) I will raise contrast of pills and add aria-expanded + aria-live changes, iterate mock with inline confirm and microcopy (use "Rollback to v2.3") — update by EOD. 2) @Arjun will scope A/B test for CTA copy. 3) @Sam to validate performance/virtualization approach. tagging here so we can track in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-890.
Arjun (PM): thanks — sounds good. please add a small note in the figma about keyboard order and focus-state so Elaine can re-check after update. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): will prototype virtualization and share PR link once ready.
Elaine (A11y): I'll re-run a quick contrast test once mock updated. cheers.
Mia (Design): thanks everyone — will post updated figma + annotated screenshot when done. :sparkles:
